_comment: Final ISLES'26 submission: 10 models — ResEnc-L x5 folds + ResEncM-Viola2Plus (copy-paste trained) folds {0,2,4,5,6}. TTA disabled, patch_batch=4. Post-processing calibrated on out-of-fold predictions (threshold 0.35 + volume-conditioned component filtering + empty-case rule).

routing._comment: Cases whose largest anatomical spacing exceeds this value route to the 'thick' arm; only 'thin' models are configured, so all cases fall back to thin.
